intro: Twenty-seven cloud-security articles published between 2026-04-13 and 2026-10-08 are collected here. Coverage spans technology, government, healthcare, cloud-services, and financial services, with activity reported across Global, EU, Israel, and North america. Alluring Pisces, APT41, and PCPJack appear among the tracked threat actors. Prominent vulnerabilities include CVE-2026-33413 and CVE-2026-6389, both rated CVSS 8.8, alongside CVE-2025-29927, CVE-2025-48703, and CVE-2025-55182. The severity mix comprises 17 high, 3 informational, and 2 critical items.
